item.title: Issue #2818 created
item.description:
Generalized casts: wildcards, error codes

1. Wildcards

The current spec disallows casts to array(*), map(*), and record(*):

[ 1 ] cast as array(item()*)  (: ✓ :)
[ 1 ] cast as array(*)        (: ↯ :)

I would suggest also making the wildcard casts legal, in analogy with currently valid instance of checks.

2. XPTY0155 → XPTY0004

If I read the spec correctly, different error codes are to be raised, depending on the cast target:

1 cast as map(xs:string, xs:integer)  (: XPTY0004 :)
1 cast as record(a)                   (: XPTY0155 :)

To avoid special-casing, I would prefer to always get XPTY0004.

…both resulting from PR #2777.
